# vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp

## Overview

[`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L1) registers the `glsl.return` ShaderRenderCase-based group through [`createReturnTests()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L523-L526), which is attached under the GLSL package in [`vktTestPackage.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/vktTestPackage.cpp#L1253-L1268). The file generates vertex-stage and fragment-stage render cases for return statements in helper functions, `main()`, output-write sequences, finite loops, and a loop whose increment is supplied by a zero uniform.

## Role

Registration and implementation-heavy test file. The source defines the `ShaderReturnTests` `TestCaseGroup` named `return` at [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L324-L337), registers its direct children in [`ShaderReturnTests::init()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L344-L519), and defines the `ShaderReturnCase` wrapper that supplies either a custom vertex shader or a custom fragment shader to `ShaderRenderCase` at [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L79-L116).

## Test Families

### single_return_vertex / single_return_fragment — Helper-function return

The first two children are explicitly added in [`ShaderReturnTests::init()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L346-L375). Each shader calls `getColor()` and the helper returns `coords.xyz`, using vertex input `a_coords` for the vertex case and fragment input `v_coords` for the fragment case.

### conditional_return_* — Conditional helper-function return

The conditional helper-function cases are generated by nested loops over `ReturnMode` and shader stage at [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L377-L387). `makeConditionalReturnInFuncCase()` emits a helper whose first branch returns `coords.xyz` and whose fallback returns `coords.wzy`; the condition is `true`, `false`, or `coords.x + coords.y >= 0.0` depending on the selected return mode at [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L139-L187).

### double_return_vertex / double_return_fragment — Unreachable second return

The double-return cases are explicit children at [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L390-L421). The helper function first returns `coords.xyz` and then contains a second return of `coords.wzy`, so the expected result follows the first return path.

### last_statement_in_main_vertex / last_statement_in_main_fragment — Final return in `main()`

The final-return cases are explicit children at [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L423-L447). The shaders write the expected `coords.xyz` color and then execute `return;` as the last statement in `main()`.

### output_write_in_func_* and output_write_* — Return between output writes

The output-write cases are generated by loops over helper-function versus `main()` placement, return mode, and shader stage at [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L449-L463). `makeOutputWriteReturnCase()` first writes `coords.xyz`, conditionally executes `return;`, and otherwise overwrites the output with `coords.wzy`; the in-function variant places that sequence in `myfunc()`, while the direct variant places it in `main()` at [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L189-L249).

### return_in_static_loop_* and return_in_dynamic_loop_* — Conditional return inside finite loops

The static-loop and dynamic-loop cases are generated by loops over loop kind, return mode, and shader stage at [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L465-L479). `makeReturnInLoopCase()` emits `getCoords()` with an iteration limit of literal `1` for static-loop cases or uniform `ui_one` for dynamic-loop cases; inside the loop it returns `coords` when the selected condition is true and otherwise swizzles `coords = coords.wzyx` before falling through to the final return at [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L251-L306).

### return_in_infinite_loop_vertex / return_in_infinite_loop_fragment — Return from a zero-increment loop

The final two children are explicit cases at [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L481-L518). Each shader declares `ui_zero`, uses `for (int i = 1; i < 10; i += ui_zero)`, and returns the input coordinates from the loop body before the fallback `coords.wzyx` return can be reached when `ui_zero` is zero.

## Parameter Dimensions

| Dimension | Observed values / evidence |
|---|---|
| Return mode | `always`, `never`, and `dynamic` are the names returned for `RETURNMODE_ALWAYS`, `RETURNMODE_NEVER`, and `RETURNMODE_DYNAMIC` at [`getReturnModeName()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L308-L322), with enum values defined at [`ReturnMode`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L40-L47). |
| Shader stage | Each generated family iterates `isFragment` over vertex and fragment cases, appending `_vertex` or `_fragment` to the registered name at [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L377-L387), [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L449-L463), and [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L465-L479). |
| Vertex versus fragment shader wiring | `ShaderReturnCase` installs the supplied source as the vertex shader for vertex cases and uses a pass-through fragment shader, or installs it as the fragment shader for fragment cases and uses a pass-through vertex shader at [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L87-L116). |
| Return condition expression | Builder functions specialize `RETURNCOND` as `true`, `false`, or `coords.x + coords.y >= 0.0` for conditional-return, output-write, and loop families at [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L170-L183), [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L232-L245), and [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L289-L302). |
| Output-write placement | `inFunc` selects the `output_write_in_func_` prefix when the write/return/write sequence is emitted inside `myfunc()` and the `output_write_` prefix when emitted directly in `main()` at [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L449-L459). |
| Loop iteration source | Static-loop cases use `ITERLIMIT = 1`, dynamic-loop cases use `ITERLIMIT = ui_one`, and both are constructed with `ReturnTestUniformSetup(UI_ONE)` at [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L251-L306). |
| Zero-increment loop uniform | The infinite-loop vertex and fragment cases use `ReturnTestUniformSetup(UI_ZERO)` and a `ui_zero` loop increment at [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L481-L518). |

## Support / Feature Requirements

No return-family-specific `checkSupport()` override is present in [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L79-L526). The cases use the shared `ShaderRenderCase` path, whose constructors store the evaluator and uniform setup at [`vktShaderRender.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRender.cpp#L577-L599), add vertex and fragment GLSL sources in [`ShaderRenderCase::initPrograms()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRender.cpp#L607-L625), and create a `ShaderRenderCaseInstance` at [`vktShaderRender.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRender.cpp#L628-L632). The inspected return-test source does not add extension or optional-feature checks beyond that shared render-test infrastructure.

Loop cases with uniforms rely on `ReturnTestUniformSetup`, which binds one integer uniform at binding `0` at [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L122-L135). The shared `useUniform()` helper maps `UI_ZERO` to integer `0` and `UI_ONE` to integer `1` at [`vktShaderRender.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRender.cpp#L945-L965).

## Verification Methods

`ShaderReturnCase` derives from `ShaderRenderCase`, so each case renders an image and compares it against a CPU-generated reference image. The shared instance renders, copies the result image, computes a vertex or fragment reference according to `m_isVertexCase`, and compares with `compareImages(resImage, refImage, 0.2f)` at [`ShaderRenderCaseInstance::iterate()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRender.cpp#L773-L805). The comparison uses `tcu::fuzzyCompare()` by default for `ShaderRenderCaseInstance` objects constructed through this path at [`vktShaderRender.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRender.cpp#L658-L683) and [`compareImages()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRender.cpp#L2721-L2730).

The expected colors come from three evaluation functions in the return-test file: `evalReturnAlways()` writes `coords.xyz`, `evalReturnNever()` writes `coords.wzy`, and `evalReturnDynamic()` selects between those values using `coords.x + coords.y >= 0.0f` at [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L49-L61). `getEvalFunc()` maps each `ReturnMode` to the corresponding evaluator at [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L63-L77). The shared reference path calls the evaluator per pixel for fragment cases at [`vktShaderRender.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRender.cpp#L2700-L2718), while vertex cases use the same evaluator object through the vertex-reference branch selected in [`ShaderRenderCaseInstance::iterate()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRender.cpp#L792-L797).

## Test Principles

- The file keeps one direct registered case per observable return scenario and shader stage; generated case names are visible in `ShaderReturnTests::init()` at [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L344-L519).
- Helper-function, `main()`, output-write, finite-loop, and zero-increment-loop contexts are separated so that each case has a single expected evaluator and a single registered leaf name.
- Return behavior is validated by rendered color selection: early-return paths preserve `coords.xyz`, fall-through paths produce `coords.wzy`, and dynamic paths select between them using the same coordinate predicate in shader generation and CPU reference evaluation.
- Uniform-backed loop cases use the shared uniform-binding helper to make the dynamic-loop limit equal to `1` and the zero-increment loop step equal to `0`, rather than relying on literal-only control flow in those cases.

## Notes / Uncertainties

- The inspected source shows the registration and implementation in one file; no separate return-test helper source file is included by [`vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderReturnTests.cpp#L26-L28).
- The shared `ShaderRenderCase` infrastructure supplies default uniforms when no explicit uniform setup is passed, because the constructor replaces a null setup with `new UniformSetup()` at [`vktShaderRender.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRender.cpp#L577-L599).
